title: Leadership Snapshot: QBR Email Sequence & Exec Sponsor Update
content:
PURPOSE:
A compact, reusable QBR-facing kit for Customer Success Managers to engage executive sponsors and broader leadership at customers. This file contains a 4-message email sequence (pre, reminder, day-of, post-QBR recap), a 2-line executive update template for leadership, a short renewal-ask playbook, and a lightweight renewal tracker snippet. Intended as a working draft — adapt tone to account tier and relationship maturity.

AUDIENCE:
- Executive sponsor (CRO/CTO/Head of AI)
- Product/Platform leadership (VPs, Directors)
- CS partner and AM

OVERVIEW / GUIDING PRINCIPLES:
- Keep exec communication succinct (2 lines + 4 bullets).
- Surface value (latency/cost/availability impact) and customer outcomes (time-to-value, feature adoption).
- Include 1 clear ask and 1 optional low-friction next step.
- Always attach an optional one-pager: "QBR TL;DR" with top KPIs and health indicators.

EMAIL SEQUENCE (timing and templates)
1) PRE-QBR: 14 days before
Subject variants: "Draft QBR agenda + quick prep ({{customer_name}})" | "Planning: QBR on {{qbr_date}} — agenda + pre-reads"
Body (short):
Hi {{exec_name}},

We’re preparing a short QBR for {{customer_name}} on {{qbr_date}}. Draft agenda attached — goal is 30 minutes focused on adoption, outcomes, and next-quarter priorities. Please confirm: any specific items you want added?

TL;DR (2 lines): 
- Wins: average inference latency down {{latency_reduction_pct}}% vs baseline.
- Risk: token spend trending +{{token_delta_pct}}% QoQ (explainable by X).

Suggested next step: "If useful, we can add a short deep-dive on routing/failover during the same session."

2) REMINDER: 7 days before
Subject: "Reminder: QBR on {{qbr_date}} — 30 min"
Body:
Quick reminder about our QBR. Agenda still attached. If you prefer a separate technical session, happy to schedule.

Attachments to include: QBR TL;DR one-pager, recent incident summary (if any), cost delta chart.

3) DAY-OF: 1 hour before
Subject: "QBR starting in 1 hour — link + 2-line summary"
Body:
Link: {{meeting_link}}
2-line summary for executive: 
- Adoption: {{active_applications}} apps in prod, {{monthly_requests}} monthly inference requests.
- Ask: Align on Dedicated capacity recommendation for Q3 to stabilize latency.

4) POST-QBR RECAP (within 48 hours)
Subject variants: "QBR recap + agreed actions — {{customer_name}}" | "{{customer_name}} QBR notes + next steps"
Body template:
Hi {{exec_name}} and team,

Thanks for your time today — below is a short recap and next steps. Please flag anything missing.

1) TL;DR (2 lines): 
- Outcome: We reduced p99 latency by {{p99_delta_ms}}ms via batching/quantization.
- Ask: Approve 12-week Dedicated capacity reservation to keep latency <{{latency_target_ms}}ms.

2) Highlights (3 bullets):
- Performance: p50/p95/p99 numbers and percent change QoQ.
- Cost: Unit token cost change and forecast for next quarter.
- Reliability: incidents and MTTR improvements.

3) Risks & Mitigations (2 bullets):
- Risk: Model drift on NLU tasks — Mitigation: scheduled evals + rollback plan.
- Risk: Capacity saturation in region X — Mitigation: cross-region fallback enabled.

4) Agreed actions (owner / due):
- CS to share Dedicated sizing proposal (Maya) — due: {{due_date}}.
- Eng to provide latency heatmap (Diego) — due: {{due_date}}.
- Customer to confirm renewal intent ({{exec_name}}) — due: {{due_date}}.

5) Optional attachments: billing delta, capacity plan, simple SLO dashboard link.

EXECUTIVE 2-LINE UPDATE (for sponsor inbox / Slack)
Use this as the subject line + first two lines in any executive update to ensure quick scan:
Subject: "{{customer_name}} QBR — key outcome + ask"
Body (first two lines):
- Key outcome: "QBR outcome: sustained 30% latency improvement on main model, cost per 1k tokens -8% QoQ."
- Key ask: "Decision requested: approve Dedicated reservation for Q3 to guarantee p99 < {{latency_target_ms}}ms."

When to use: If execs are short on time, drop only these two lines into Slack or email and attach the one-pager.

CUSTOMER-FACING QUARTERLY RECAP (longer form, 1 page)
Subject: "Quarterly Recap — Product outcomes + next steps for {{customer_name}}"
Body structure (full):
- One-line summary (what changed this quarter).
- Top 3 wins (bullets with metrics).
- Top 2 areas to watch (metrics + mitigation).
- Proposed investments (capacity, features, support) tagged by impact and cost.
- Close: "We propose a 30-min follow-up to finalize the capacity ask — does {{exec_name}} prefer next Tuesday or Thursday?"

RENEWAL & RENEWAL-TRACKER SNIPPET (lightweight, to paste into CRM)
- Customer: {{customer_name}}
- Renewal window: {{renewal_month}}
- Current ARR: ${{current_arr}}
- Renewal target ARR: ${{target_arr}} (includes Dedicated + premium support)
- Health score: {{health_score}}/100
- Risk level: low | medium | high (pick one)
- Next renewal touchpoint: {{next_touch_date}} (owner: {{owner_name}})
- Ask plan: tiered offers: 1) Auto-renew (no change), 2) Upsell Dedicated (commit 12 months), 3) Enterprise bundle (Dedicated + 24/7 SRE hours)

RENEWAL-ASK PLAYBOOK (short)
1) Warm phase (60–90 days out): executive reminder + 1-page value recap + usage summary.
2) Decision phase (30–45 days out): pricing options with clear delta vs current spend + case studies showing ROI.
3) Close phase (7–14 days out): legal + billing checklist, sign-off meeting with finance and procurement.

ESCALATION & SUPPORT PATH
- If renewal risk = high: schedule an "alignment call" with Sales Lead + CS Lead within 7 days.
- Technical escalation: open Priority-1 briefing with Eng Solutions (tag: eng-solutions@redwood.ai).

SAMPLE METRICS (copy/paste into one-pager)
- Active prod apps: {{active_applications}}
- Monthly inference requests: {{monthly_requests}}
- p50/p95/p99 latency (ms): {{p50}} / {{p95}} / {{p99}}
- Token spend QoQ: {{token_delta_pct}}%
- Ded. capacity recommendation: {{gpu_count}} GPUs (A100/80GB equivalent)
- Proposed commit: ${{proposed_commit}}/month

TEMPLATES & CHECKLIST (for exporter into Confluence/CRM)
- Add QBR TL;DR (1p) + attach: performance chart (p99), cost delta, incident timeline.
- Update CRM renewal field with "next_touch_date" after Post-QBR recap sent.
- Follow up: call notes in CRM and share one-pager with procurement.

NOTES & OPEN QUESTIONS (work-in-progress)
- Tone variants: tighten for enterprise finance vs product execs.
- Add a short ROI paragraph when the customer has clear $ savings from latency/cost improvements.
- Confirm owner for capacity sizing: usually CS + Solutions Eng.

APPENDIX: SAMPLE SHORT EMAILS (copy-ready)
Short ask email (for exec):
Subject: "Decision requested: Dedicated commit to secure p99 < {{latency_target_ms}}ms"
Hi {{exec_name}},

Quick ask: approve the attached Dedicated sizing to keep p99 under {{latency_target_ms}}ms. This reduces expected customer-facing errors by {{error_reduction_pct}}% and saves an estimated ${{estimated_savings}} QoQ. Approval needed by {{approval_deadline}} to lock Q3 pricing.

Thanks,
{{your_name}}

Closing thoughts: keep this file as a living template. Replace placeholders before sending and attach the one-pager. For any contentious renewals, loop in Sales Leader and Solutions Engineer 2 weeks before decision date.
